summary.text: Bob Phillips is a Democratic state representative from District 51 who took office on January 4, 2011 and is seeking re-election; he advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as banker.

paragraphs.text: Phillips earned a B.S. in business administration from the University of Rhode Island, and his professional experience includes working for Citizens Bank, according to Ballotpedia.
